method: Every catalogue hold effect is a reviewed family. reviewed_refs must equal the set of pinned src/**/*.c references to that HOLD_EFFECT_* symbol (AI, debug and animation sources excluded), so a new or moved read fails source-check instead of silently inheriting a decision. identity_reference_sites must equal the set of enclosing definitions of literal ITEM_* catalogue symbols in pinned src/battle_*.c. Categories are reviewed input; the generator never infers one. form_change_item_identities must equal every ITEM_* identity in pinned src/data/pokemon/form_change_tables.h with its methods; an identity with a battle-time held method (FORM_CHANGE_BEGIN_BATTLE or FORM_CHANGE_BATTLE_*) may never be PROVEN_NO_ORDINARY_DAMAGE_EFFECT.
